2. Heard Mr.R.Rameshraja, learned counsel for petitioner and Mr.A.Selvendran, learned Special Government Pleader appearing for respondent.
3. The case of the petitioner is that he and his son were owning certain properties.
An extent of 318 sq.mts. in Survey No.60/7A2 and an extent of 4740 sq.mts. in Survey No.60/7B2 was acquired by the Highways Department for road extension project.
The petitioner and his son gave no objection for the acquisition.
Thereafter, notice came to be issued under Section 3E(1) of the National Highways Act directing the petitioner to produce necessary documents for the purpose of ascertaining the compensation.
Accordingly, all the records were submitted and the competent authority fixed compensation of Rs.14,05,317/- through proceedings dated 05.02.2021 payable to the land owners.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 4.
The petitioner and his son were informed that a suit is pending in O.S.No.168 of 2016 before the District Munsif cum Judicial Magistrate, Hosur, pertaining to the subject property.

entities.text: District Munsif cum Judicial Magistrate, Hosur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: In view of the same, the compensation amount was not paid to the petitioner and his son.

5. It is the specific case of the petitioner that the said suit in O.S.No.168 of 2016 was filed by one Geetha against the petitioner and his son and this suit came to be dismissed for default as early as on 31.03.2023.
This suit has not been restored and no appeal has been filed.
6. In view of the above development, notice was issued to the respondents to pay the compensation amount since the suit is no longer pending.
In spite of receipt of the same, the compensation amount was not paid to the petitioner and his son and it is under these circumstances, the present writ petition has been filed before this Court.

7. Taking into consideration the facts and circumstances of the case and the materials placed before this Court and the fact that the compensation has already been determined through proceedings d a t e d 0 5 . 0 2 . 2 0 2 1 a n d t h e p e n d i n g s u i t h a s a l s o b e e n d i s m i s s e d f o r n o n - https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis prosecution, there shall be a direction to the respondents to pay the eligible compensation to the petitioner within a period of six (6) weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.

For this purpose, the compensation amount shall be handed over by the first respondent to the second respondent within a period of three (3) weeks and the compensation amount shall be paid to the petitioner within a period of three (3) weeks thereafter.
This writ petition is disposed of with the above direction.
No costs.
